name: How much of a luxury home budget should go to finishes and fixtures?

mainEntity.name: What percentage of a luxury home budget should be allocated to finishes, fixtures, and custom millwork?
mainEntity.text: What percentage of a luxury home budget should be allocated to finishes, fixtures, and custom millwork?

acceptedAnswer.text: Luxury homes spend far more on finishes than typical projects because the quality is visible in every room. Budget allocation depends on the home’s size and style, but custom cabinetry, stone slab selections, lighting, plumbing fixtures, doors, windows, and specialty finishes can consume a major portion of the total project budget. Millwork is especially important because it affects kitchens, closets, baths, wall panels, stair details, and built-in storage. In Los Angeles luxury homes, buyers often underestimate how quickly premium materials add up. One upgraded kitchen can equal the cost of several standard rooms. A smart approach is to decide early where the home should feel truly custom and where a simpler solution is acceptable. That prevents overspending in less visible areas while protecting the spaces that matter most. The best luxury budgets are organized by room and by finish category, not just by a single lump sum.
acceptedAnswer.description: In a luxury home, finishes, fixtures, millwork, and custom details can absorb a much larger share of the budget than in standard construction. High-end cabinetry, stone, hardware, lighting, and specialty surfaces often require a substantial allocation because these items define the final look and feel of the home.
